description: Source code for the Stock Ledger Entry doctype in ERPNext, including class definitions, validation methods, and database indexing functions.

classes.name: StockFreezeError
classes.description: Validation error for frozen stock transactions.

classes.name: BackDatedStockTransaction
classes.description: Validation error for backdated stock transactions.

classes.name: StockLedgerEntry
classes.description: Main class representing a stock ledger entry with validation and processing methods.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates a temporary unique name for the document for fast insertion.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before saving the stock ledger entry.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Processes actions upon submission, including stock frozen date check and batch quantity calculation.

methods.name: calculate_batch_qty
methods.description: Updates the batch quantity based on current stock ledger entries.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures all mandatory fields are filled and actual quantity is provided when required.

methods.name: validate_item
methods.description: Validates item details, batch number, and stock item constraints.

methods.name: check_stock_frozen_date
methods.description: Checks if the transaction date is within the allowed frozen period.

methods.name: scrub_posting_time
methods.description: Normalizes the posting time to '00:00' if not provided.

methods.name: validate_batch
methods.description: Validates batch expiry date against posting date.

methods.name: validate_and_set_fiscal_year
methods.description: Sets or validates the fiscal year for the transaction.

methods.name: block_transactions_against_group_warehouse
methods.description: Checks if the warehouse is a group warehouse and blocks if necessary.

methods.name: on_doctype_update
methods.description: Creates database indexes for the Stock Ledger Entry doctype.
